notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person
notice.quote: The fence viewer shall notify in writing the person who made the request and the owner or owners of the property to be viewed not less than 5 days before the date on which the fence viewer will render his or her services.

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer
appeal.quote_through: (4) A person may appeal the decision of a fence viewer to a court of competent jurisdiction.

access.label: The person can see the record

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire

boundary.label: What it takes from you, and the limits on that

plain-words.label: Can an ordinary reader follow it
plain-words.quote_longest: If there is a decision made for the division of costs of constructing or maintaining a fence by a fence viewer, or through mutual written agreement of the parties recorded in the office of the clerk of each township, city, and village or in the office of the county register of de

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: (1) The owner of real property who constructs a fence shall pay for the construction and maintenance of that fence.
fair-exchange.quote_gets: The fence viewer shall be compensated 80% of the amount received by the township treasurer or city or village treasurer under section 6(2) when the requested service has been performed.
